scope: Unscored main-thread profiling during physical hover; no latency or playback qualification
interpretation: Most sampled main-thread stacks are waiting in the ordinary event-loop Mach receive. No sustained feature drawing/decode work appears in this unscored sparse-hover profile. This does not identify the presentation tail seen under ScreenCaptureKit or prove absence of short blocks.
limitations: Sparse physical hovers, no capture observer
1ms statistical sampling may miss short operations
Timing is not percentile qualification; profiler changes scheduling
